detail.longDescription: I have accumulated gigabytes of smartphone photos over the past decade that i have not been able to properly manage or cleanup systematically. Has anyone been successful at using AI and a multitude of agentic tools to do things like * identify photos as candidates for deletion based on them being blurry or poorly composed or being duplicates * cluster photos as being part of a particular trip or particular iterinary based on their geographical and time proximity * Cleanup photos based on other arbitrary criteria, like i do a video walkthrough of a car i rent and i dont need these walkthrough 1 year after or so. Any other ideas ot bring some sanity to an ever-growing library of smartphone photos using AI.
